'''Darhoff 7''' is a 3★ [[Great Sword]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is designed by Endfield Arsenal Engineer Darhoff. Its designs offer a viable option for those taking part in assault operations.}}
